text: Prior weather disruption on Mumbai to Rotterdam lane caused 22 hour delay. Best mitigation was early customer notification and berth rebooking at Jebel Ali.
Chicago to Toronto shipments with elevated border queues recovered when customs documents were sent six hours before arrival at Windsor.
Yantian terminal congestion produced rolled sailings for high-volume export lanes. Alternate feeder through Nansha reduced dwell time.
Air cargo documentation exceptions at GRU often require broker escalation and corrected commercial invoice within two hours to protect connection windows.
Missed cold chain checkpoints are high-priority anomalies. Operations should verify sensor telemetry, product temperature range, and next scan location.
